description: A neon marker stroke that animates horizontally across an existing text label, like a highlighter dragged left-to-right. Use it on top of an already-rendered text asset (anchors and timing intentionally overlap) for the classic vox 'FinFET Architecture' callout beat.

text.description: the label the marker sweeps across; rendered behind the marker so the highlight sits over real type

markerColorToken.description: color token for the highlighter band

typography.description: typography token for the rendered text

markerBlur.description: gaussian blur on the marker band in px

underline.description: when true, render the marker as a thin underline instead of a filled band
